$description: The sample test on home: three questions in the JEE Main style, marked like JEE Main (exam.jee-main-marking). The answer is the index of the right option. Questions and solutions are checked by hand; a teacher should review them before launch.
markingNote: Marked like JEE Main: {{fact:exam.jee-main-marking#right}} for a right answer, {{fact:exam.jee-main-marking#wrong}} for a wrong one, {{fact:exam.jee-main-marking#blank}} for a question left.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A ball is thrown straight up at 20 m/s. Taking g = 10 m/s², how high does it rise?
questions.solution: At the top the ball stops, so v² = 2gh. That gives h = 20² ÷ (2 × 10) = 20 m.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: 0.5 mol of aluminium reacts with excess HCl: 2Al + 6HCl → 2AlCl₃ + 3H₂. How many moles of H₂ form?
questions.solution: 2 mol of Al give 3 mol of H₂. So 0.5 mol of Al gives 0.5 × 3 ÷ 2 = 0.75 mol of H₂.

questions.subject: maths
questions.text: What is the value of ∫₀¹ x·e^(x²) dx?
questions.solution: Put u = x², so du = 2x dx. The integral becomes ½ ∫₀¹ eᵘ du = (e − 1) ÷ 2.
